
## Cruces flagged as guesses (Pass 1, reviewer)

Drafter’s flagged items; each is a guess in the unit’s note and is not resolved by the grammar. Reviewer’s comment in brackets.

- 2957 · ǣht boden / segn / freoðowong: ‘ǣht’ taken as “pursuit” (Holthausen ‘ōht’, Sievers ‘sæcc’ for ‘segn’); ‘segn’ singular with plural ‘ofereōdon’; ‘freoðowong’ as the cleared ground round the fort. [Also the stop after ‘lēodum’ vs after ‘Higelāce(s)’ changes how ‘segn Higelāces’ attaches.]
- 2962 · blondenfexa: “blended-haired” rendered “grey-haired”; the colour is inferred (cf. 1791, 1873 in published parts).
- 2981 · dropen: ‘wæs in feorh dropen’, participle of ‘drēopan’, “dropped into the life”; “mortally struck” is from the context. [The drafter’s alternative ‘drīfan’ was removed: the form is impossible.]
- 2990 · (mid) lēodum: manuscript ‘leana’ + gap + ‘lēodū’; ‘(mid)’ is Grundtvig’s and others’ filling (Kemble ‘on’, Grein ‘his’, Heyne etc. ‘fore/for’).
- 2994 · hund þūsenda: unit of the sum not named (land and rings “to the worth of”).
- 2995 · him: Eofor and Wulf, or the king (“no one need blame him”); also ‘ðā’ as “then” or the plural article.
- 3001 · Swēona lēoda: case of ‘lēoda’ and force of ‘tō’; Kemble ‘lēode’; rendered “from the Swedes’ people” by the sense.
- 3005 · hwate Sǣ-Gēatas (MS scildingas): Klaeber’s emendation (JEGPh viii 259); Heyne ‘Scilfingas’, Holthausen/Sedgefield with the line moved after 3001; construction taken as apposition to ‘hæleða’ with Beowulf the subject of the singular verbs. [Rebuilt in Pass 1.]
- 3034 · hlimbed: rare word, “couch, bed”; first element unclear.
- 3038 · Ǣr … gesēgan: ‘ǣr’ disputed (Thorpe ‘ac’, Grundtvig ‘ǣc’, Bugge drops ‘þǣr’, Sievers/Holthausen/Sedgefield ‘þǣr hī þā’); taken as “before”.
- 3041 · gry(refāh): manuscript breaks off after ‘gry’; Thorkelin ‘gryre’, Heyne ‘gryregæst’, Bugge/Sedgefield/Chambers ‘gryrefāh’.
- 3047 · bunan / orcas: “cups” and “flagons”, guessed from the glossary.
- 3052 · ēacencræftig: “enormously powerful”, rare word.

Additional doubtful readings noticed in Pass 1 (not on the drafter’s list):
- 3010 · ānes hwæt: “not one thing only”, chosen because the next lines burn the hoard; the alternative “not anything at all” contradicts them.
- 3045 · ende genyttod: “had used the end of”, sense from lexica and context.
- 2978 / 2980 · bordweal: “shield-rim”, guess.
- 2998 · hāmweorðunge: “honour for the house”, guess.
